triage.reason: The page’s 20 November 2026 news item reports a new EU ban on plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries under the Waste Shipment Regulation, a concrete regulatory development within the last 60 days.

draft.summary: The EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries. The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.
draft.source_quote:
EU bans plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries
The restrictions will apply until at least 21 May 2029, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.

key_dates.text: Restrictions on plastic waste exports to non-OECD countries apply until at least this date, after which those nations may apply to receive plastic waste from the EU.

draft.interpretation: The ban may shift plastic waste volumes towards EU recyclers and converters, while brand owners may need to review export routes for plastic packaging waste.
